enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing steadily. Turning over. Adjusting pillow. Pulling covers up. Sleeping. Waking briefly. Turning over. Adjusting position. Sleeping.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to office. Sit at desk.

Attend meeting. Update charts. End shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter house. Remove shoes. Hang coat.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Season meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat with fork. Drink water. Stand up. Clear table. Rinse dishes. Place in dishwasher.
